title: C. White, Black and White Again

legend: Polycarpus is sure that his life fits the description: "first there is a white stripe, then a black one, then a white one again". So, Polycarpus is sure that this rule is going to fulfill during the next n days. Polycarpus knows that he is in for w good events and b not-so-good events. At least one event is going to take place during each day. As each day is unequivocally characterizes as a part of a white or a black stripe, then each day is going to have events of the same type only (ether good or not-so-good).

What is the number of distinct ways this scenario can develop over the next n days if Polycarpus is in for a white stripe (a stripe that has good events only, the stripe's length is at least 1 day), the a black stripe (a stripe that has not-so-good events only, the stripe's length is at least 1 day) and a white stripe again (a stripe that has good events only, the stripe's length is at least 1 day). Each of n days will belong to one of the three stripes only.
Note that even the events of the same type are distinct from each other. Even if some events occur on the same day, they go in some order (there are no simultaneous events).

Write a code that prints the number of possible configurations to sort the events into days. See the samples for clarifications on which scenarios should be considered distinct. Print the answer modulo 1000000009 (109 + 9).
input: The single line of the input contains integers n, w and b (3 ≤ n ≤ 4000, 2 ≤ w ≤ 4000, 1 ≤ b ≤ 4000) — the number of days, the number of good events and the number of not-so-good events. It is guaranteed that w + b ≥ n.
output: Print the required number of ways modulo 1000000009 (109 + 9).
note: We'll represent the good events by numbers starting from 1 and the not-so-good events — by letters starting from 'a'. Vertical lines separate days.

In the first sample the possible ways are: "1|a|2" and "2|a|1". In the second sample the possible ways are: "1|a|b|2", "2|a|b|1", "1|b|a|2" and "2|b|a|1". In the third sample the possible ways are: "1|ab|2", "2|ab|1", "1|ba|2" and "2|ba|1".

legend.ai: Polycarpus 确信自己的生活符合这样的描述：“先是一段白色条带，然后是一段黑色条带，接着又是一段白色条带。”因此，Polycarpus 确信接下来的 n 天将遵循这一规律。Polycarpus 知道自己将经历 w 个好事件和 b 个不太好的事件。每天至少会发生一个事件。由于每天明确属于白色条带或黑色条带的一部分，因此每天只会发生同一类型的事件（要么是好的，要么是不太好的）。
如果接下来的 n 天中，Polycarpus 将经历一段白色条带（一段只包含好事件、长度至少为 1 天的条带）、一段黑色条带（一段只包含不太好的事件、长度至少为 1 天的条带），以及再次经历一段白色条带（一段只包含好事件、长度至少为 1 天的条带），那么这种情形有多少种不同的发展方式？n 天中的每一天都只属于这三段条带中的一段。
注意，即使是同一类型的事件，它们彼此也各不相同。即使某些事件发生在同一天，它们也会按照某种顺序发生（不存在同时发生的事件）。
编写程序，输出将事件安排到各天的可能方案数。请参见样例，以了解哪些情况应被视为不同。请将答案对 1000000009（10^9 + 9）取模。

input.ai: 输入的唯一一行包含整数 n、w 和 b（3 ≤ n ≤ 4000，2 ≤ w ≤ 4000，1 ≤ b ≤ 4000）——天数、好事件的数量以及不太好的事件的数量。保证 w + b ≥ n。

output.ai: 输出所需的方案数对 1000000009（10^9 + 9）取模的结果。

note.ai: 我们将好事件用从 1 开始的数字表示，将不太好的事件用从 'a' 开始的字母表示。竖线用于分隔天数。
在第一个样例中，可能的方案为："1|a|2" 和 "2|a|1"。在第二个样例中，可能的方案为："1|a|b|2"、"2|a|b|1"、"1|b|a|2" 和 "2|b|a|1"。在第三个样例中，可能的方案为："1|ab|2"、"2|ab|1"、"1|ba|2" 和 "2|ba|1"。
